records.deidentified_narrative: private property accident. 7101 gateway west is a private property parking lot (walmart). driver of unit 1 stated she was traveling northbound inside the parking lot of walmart and heading north between isles 8 and 9. driver of unit 1 stated she looked both ways and did not observe any pedestrian crossing in front of her so she turned left to head westbound inside the parking lot and right in front of walmart. driver of unit 1 stated that she then heard someone yelling and she stopped right away only to find out that she had struck unit 2 (pedestrian) and unit 3 (pedestrian). driver of unit 1 stated she stepped out of unit 1 and observed that unit 2 was pinned by/underneath the left front tire of unit 1. unit 2 was unable to explain what occurred as she was pinned underneath unit 1 and fire department personnel were working on her at the time. officer amparan tried to obtain unit 3's version of how the collision occurred, but was unable to and tried calling her at the phone number provided for her. officer amparan met with negative contact numerous times when trying to call unit 3. officer i. martinez #1706 arrived at the scene and assisted with reviewing the surveillance video footage for the walmart parking lot. officer martinez met with the loss prevention personnel at the walmart, reviewed the surveillance video and observed the two pedestrians (unit 2 and unit 3) walking through the parking lot towards the southeast entrance doors of the walmart. unit 2 and unit 3 were walking next to each other. in the video, unit 1 is seen driving the wrong direction northbound on a southbound isle, going through the parking lot going about 10 to 15 miles per hour. the driver of unit 1 appears to be looking to the right, was not slowing down and turned left, at which time, she struck unit 2 and unit 3. witness-1 (venegas, irene: phone;[phone]): stated she was walking northbound in the parking lot by the isle to the right of unit 1 (isle 8). witness-1 stated she observed that unit 1 was going at a normal speed/did not appear excessive to her. witness-1 began turning as she was going to enter walmart thru the general merchandise door which was to her right. witness-1 observed that unit 1 did not stop or slow down when she approached the lined area/isle directly in front of walmart and made the left turn to head west. witness-1 then heard a loud thump by where unit 1 was at. shortly after, witness-1 then heard a vehicle braking hard. witness-1 turned around to her left and observed unit 3 yelling and cursing at the driver of unit 1. witness-1 thought unit 1 had struck unit 3 and learned that unit 1 had also struck unit 2 who was pinned underneath the left front tire of unit 1. witness-1 waited with unit 2 and had unit 3 dial 911 for medical assistance. unit 2 complained of pain to her head, hands, legs and was transported for treatment. officer amparan learned that unit 2 sustained a laceration to her head and a skull fracture. unit 2 also sustained several fractures to both her legs and possible laceration to one of her wrist, but was in stable condition. unit 3 was possibly injured as well, but the officers were unable to make contact with her to list her injuries if any. no other injuries or witnesses reported.

records.deidentified_narrative: on sunday [date] at approximately 0017 hours, i, deputy a. renz #5993 with the travis county sheriff's department was on duty and dispatched to an accident with a pedestrian in the parking lot of the blake manor food mart located at [roadway] in austin, texas. dispatch stated that a female victim was struck by a red ford fusion or similar make and model vehicle that then left the scene without rendering aid. i was wearing a standard travis county sheriff's department uniform and was driving a marked patrol unit #4690. once on scene, i made contact with the victim to the call and identified her as sadie eve corter (w/f, [date]). corter stated that just prior to police responding, she was struck by an unknown female subject in a newer model red ford fusion in the parking lot of the convenience store. corter stated that she was hit when walking from the entrance of store to her vehicle near the fuel pumps. at that time, the suspect vehicle reversed from a front row parking space and crashed into her with its trunk. as a result, corter stated that she launched up in the air and on to the truck. the vehicle then briefly paused according to witnesses and then drove off hurriedly without stopping or checking on corter. i observed corter to be in physical pain and asked if she was hurt. corter acknowledged that she was hurt on her entire left side where she was struck and rated the pain level of her injury at a 6 on a traditional scale of 1-10 (1 being no pain and 10 being extreme pain). corter had no visible injury on her upper body but was unable to check her left leg due to full length pants. corter estimated the speed of the impact at 15 miles per hour. given possibility that corter was injured, i requested ems to respond and examine her. corter refused transport and remained on scene. from there i contacted store management to inquire about video surveillance footage. the cashier on duty stated that he had no access and requested that investigators contact the property manager at a later date. the cashier did not provide a managers name. lastly, i identified all witnesses to the collision. i located three and each corroborated the narrative of corter with little added detail. witnesses:ana derosa (w/f,[date])nathan russell (w/m, [date])sean garner (w/m, [date])both audio and video are available from the arbitrator system of my patrol unit and no bwc footage is available. for more information, please reference the cr-3 report. no suspect or suspect vehicle was located. eor.
